description: The fleet's Renovate run (StartupBros-com/home-infrastructure, renovate-config.js) sets the schedule, PR limits, release-age floors and automerge. Since .github/dependabot.yml was deleted, that run also pins and updates the GitHub Actions. This file adds only what this repository needs.

packageRules.description: The Bun runtime moves by hand, in .bun-version, the Dockerfile, package.json and this file's constraints together (docs/contributing.md, "Bumping the Bun toolchain"). Renovate names those pins bun, oven/bun (the Dockerfile image) and oven-sh/bun (constraints.bun, a GitHub release).

scripts/__tests__/router-release-workflow.test.ts asserts this action's exact commit, because it receives the release App's private key: a bump fails there until someone has read its action.yml and main.js (docs/hov-router-releases.md, "Evidence required for each release"). A group of its own puts it on its own branch, so that expected failure holds back none of the month's other Actions updates.
